title: Deprecate legacy session cookies in favor of JWT
description: Ensure all backend services accept Bearer JWT tokens issued by Keycloak. Session cookies will be retired by end of Q1.

title: Implement Stripe webhook retry handling with idempotency keys
description: Payment events from Stripe occasionally fail due to timeout. We must persist idempotency keys in Redis/FalkorDB to avoid double billing.

title: Audit database access permissions for production clusters
description: Elena verified that only IAM-authenticated pods in Kubernetes can connect to production data stores.
